notes: Fair Work Week Ordinance (LAMC Ch. XVIII Art. 5) covers retail businesses (NAICS) with 300+ employees globally; employees who work 2+ hours a week in the City of Los Angeles. Effective April 1, 2023.
Clopening (<10 h between shifts spanning two workdays) requires written consent and 1.5x pay for the second shift (extra key premium_applies_to='shift').

Predictability pay (wagesla.lacity.gov FWW page; Rules Reg. 5): increase in hours over 15 min = 1 h at regular rate; change to the date, time, or location = 1 h for EACH change (moving a shift to another day and start time = 2 h, moved_premium_per_attribute); reduction of 15+ min or unfulfilled on-call = 1/2 x hours not worked at regular rate.

Consent does not waive pay: 'Predictability Pay is required when the change is initiated by the Employer, even if the Employee consents to that change In Writing' (Reg. 5). Exemptions (Reg. 5.1): employee-initiated change; employee accepts an employer-initiated change due to another scheduled employee's absence (must be told it is voluntary, may decline, and no predictability pay); accepted offers of additional hours under LAMC 185.05; discipline; force majeure; hours paid at overtime under Lab. Code 510. Employees asked to leave early voluntarily are still owed pay (FAQ 47).
'In Writing' includes emails, text messages, scheduling or messaging apps (Rules, definitions). Changes made with <14 days' notice need the employee's written consent.
Coverage: 300+ employees globally, principal NAICS retail trade (44-45); employees working 2+ hours a week in the City of LA.

params.exemption_note: Exempt when "An Employee accepts a schedule change initiated by an Employer due to an absence of another scheduled Employee"; employer must say acceptance is voluntary, the employee may decline, and no Predictability Pay is owed.

rules.summary: LA retail (300+ employees globally): inside 14 days, 1 hour at the regular rate for added hours (>15 min) and 1 hour per change of date, time or location; reductions of 15+ min pay half the hours not worked. Voluntarily covering an absent coworker is exempt.
